title: Chapter 1390 - 9: The Great Emperor’S Twilight Years
content:
Chapter 1390 - 9: The Great Emperor’S Twilight Years

Chapter 1390: Chapter 9: The Great Emperor’s Twilight Years

Because Lin Yuan’s mental will would never decay.

Secondly, a series of hidden dangers brought by Lin Yuan’s identity as a Great Emperor of the current age.

Being able to become an Emperor of the Human Race, even if ordinary, one has emerged through mountains of corpses and seas of blood.

In the past, Emperor Tianyuan had killed countless foreign geniuses, including direct descendants of those Heavenly Emperor Supremes.

At Emperor Tianyuan’s peak, these alien races naturally could only endure, even if there were many foundations within the clans, including former Heavenly Emperor Supremes who have self-inflicted a slash.

They were unwilling to engage in a bloody fight with a peak Great Emperor.

Besides the alien races, there were also many Forbidden Zone Masters eyeing Emperor Tianyuan covetously.

The Origin Source of a contemporary Great Emperor is enough to nourish the gradually twisted mental will of these Forbidden Zone Masters.

...

"In this world, the power of the Human Race is weak, extremely insignificant among the Myriad Clans. Before the rise of Emperor Tianyuan, the Human Race had never birthed a strongman at the Emperor level."

Thought Lin Yuan.

So after Emperor Tianyuan became the Ultimate, the Human Race experienced rapid expansion.

Facing the Human Race, with Emperor Tianyuan holding ground, other alien races could only retreat.

Unfortunately, Emperor Tianyuan did not cultivate the next Great Emperor for the Human Race.

It is foreseeable that once Emperor Tianyuan falls, the Human Race will face purging backlash from other alien races.

Lin Yuan, taking over Emperor Tianyuan, possesses all the memories of this contemporary Great Emperor.

Clearly, Emperor Tianyuan also made many preparations for after his fall.

For example, as early as a hundred thousand years ago, he began to make the Human Race shrink its power.

Now the power occupied by the Human Race is less than one-thousandth of the peak period a million years ago.

Moreover, Emperor Tianyuan also tried to self-inflict a slash, like those Heavenly Emperor Supremes who barely clung on.

But to self-inflict a slash requires going to the ’Yellow Springs’ Forbidden Zone, soaking in the Yellow Springs for ten thousand years.

Only in this way can the life span be extended, with the cost being the transformation into a Yellow Springs body, and from then on forever unable to advance further.

However, when Emperor Tianyuan was young, he had killed several offspring of the ’Yellow Springs’ Forbidden Zone Master, thus forming a deadly feud between the two.

Alone, heading to the Yellow Springs Forbidden Zone, Emperor Tianyuan was unwilling and eventually gave up this method.

In fact, through the ages, not many Great Emperor Heavenly Emperor Supremes are willing to self-inflict a slash.

The cost of soaking in the Yellow Springs is far more than just being unable to advance further.

...

Emperor Tianyuan made many preparations for the Human Race, wanting it to continue as much as possible after his death.

However, Lin Yuan observed the future timeline and knew that after Emperor Tianyuan’s death, the Human Race would be wiped out by those powerful alien races.

Strong alien races do not want to see another Great Emperor emerge for the Human Race in the future, so to ensure foolproof, they directly joined forces and annihilated the Human Race.

And Emperor Tianyuan himself?

The emperor’s body was divided among those Forbidden Zone Masters.

This was Emperor Tianyuan’s final outcome.

Of course, this was the conclusion before Lin Yuan arrived.

After Lin Yuan’s arrival, all outcomes naturally got rewritten.

...

"The current urgent matter is to quickly restore full strength."

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

In this Fang Yuan World, the Great Emperor is the pinnacle of strength.

Above the Great Emperor, there is the Red Dust Immortal.

Only the Red Dust Immortal can break the limit of lifespan and live freely.

And the Red Dust Immortal corresponds to the thirteenth-rank time life.

The Red Dust Immortal, though named Red Dust, is not within the Red Dust.

But resides at a higher level of the Great Wilderness Origin World.

...

The Red Dust Immortal is also the ultimate pursuit of all past Great Emperors, Heavenly Emperors, and Supremes.

However, to become a Red Dust Immortal, one must not only break through the time cycle but also gather enough immortal material.

Using immortal material to nurture the physical body, soul, and mental spirit, gradually transforming to the level of Red Dust Immortal.

Past Great Emperors have all tried condensing immortal material.

However, even with the power of a Great Emperor, it takes tens of millions or even hundreds of millions of years to gather enough immortal material.

That means at least a Great Emperor who has lived through seven or eight generations can gather enough immortal material to face the test of time cycles.

Lin Yuan’s mental will is already at the level of time life, with no need to go through another time cycle, thus only needs to condense a sufficient amount of immortal material to return to peak strength.

"Immortal material?"

Lin Yuan carefully felt, immediately discovering some thin auras permeating between heaven and earth.

Containing the aura of immortality and eternity.

These are the so-called immortal material.

"Ordinary Great Emperors need tens of millions or even hundreds of millions of years to condense enough immortal material, but I don’t need that long."

Lin Yuan thought to himself, he is not a Great Emperor, his true realm is at the level of a time life equivalent to Red Dust Immortal. The speed of condensing immortal material is unknown how many times that of those Great Emperors.

...

You Clan.

The Great Wilderness Origin World’s nine most powerful clans.

The You Clan is one of them and ranks at least in the top three of the terrifying clans.

In the history of the You Clan, ten Heavenly Emperors were born, and from time to time they would overlook the Great Wilderness Origin World.

At this time, in the deepest part of the You Clan’s ancestral land, a pair of eyes resembling those who had been asleep for countless eons opened, with a cold gaze, looking towards the Tianyuan Emperor Palace.

Subsequently, another pair of eyes opened, also looking towards the Tianyuan Emperor Palace.

The Tianyuan Emperor Palace is the residence of the current Great Emperor, Emperor Tianyuan, and the core place of the newly elevated one of the nine major clans, the Human Race.

"Tianyuan should also die of old age, right."

"With Tianyuan’s core accumulation, he certainly cannot break his own shackles and live out a third life."

Several You Clan Heavenly Emperors, who had self-inflicted a slash, discussed among themselves, speculating the current state of Emperor Tianyuan.

"Wait a little longer, and then we will revive, break into the Tianyuan Emperor Palace, and divide the Emperor’s body."

One of the You Clan Heavenly Emperors whispered, having once been Great Emperors Heavenly Emperors overlooking the Great Wilderness Origin World, but now, due to long slumber and the impact of the Yellow Springs body on themselves, they crave to devour the Emperor’s physical body.

"Right, Tianyuan is just there, he can’t go anywhere."

Other You Clan Heavenly Emperors nodded, they are not willing to face Emperor Tianyuan who still has a breath left, due to their strength not matching a true Great Emperor after self-inflicting a slash.

...

Forbidden Zone ’Yellow Springs’.

Simultaneously, pairs of eyes opened, carefully observing the Tianyuan Emperor Palace.

"Tianyuan has not come until now, presumably because he does not trust us, does not trust Yellow Springs."

"Fine, although this makes it a bit troublesome, the Origin Source of the contemporary Great Emperor is more than enough to greatly nourish our nearly depleted spirit, enough for us to personally take action once."

Existences within the ’Yellow Springs’ Forbidden Zone were quick to exchange, if Emperor Tianyuan had done as they said, obediently coming to the Forbidden Zone, then being suppressed, and having his Origin Source absorbed and devoured.

It would be the best result.

But obviously, Emperor Tianyuan had doubts.

He would rather die of old age than come.

Which the existences in the ’Yellow Springs’ Forbidden Zone found troublesome.

But it was only troublesome.

At worst, further revival, with the nourishment of a contemporary Great Emperor’s Origin Source, was enough to cover their revival costs.

...

Those focusing on Emperor Tianyuan are far more than just the You Clan and the ’Yellow Springs’ Forbidden Zone.

Many special and taboo existences are observing the state of Emperor Tianyuan.

To be able to divide the contemporary Great Emperor Tianyuan at the first moment possible.

It should be known that even if a contemporary Great Emperor is at the limit of lifespan, the physical body is still at its peak, it is the mental will that is exhausted.

Compared to those who have self-inflicted a slash and endured long eras, contemporary Great Emperors in the eyes of those taboo existences are an incomparable ’delicacy’.

...

Within the Tianyuan Emperor Palace.

Lin Yuan is attempting to condense immortal material.

Strands of aura were stripped from heaven and earth, almost materializing as they converged before Lin Yuan.

If there were any other Heavenly Emperor Supremes present, they would definitely be shocked and dumbfounded, as even they, to condense immortal material, can only rely on the accumulation over long eras.

As for the scene where immortal material gathers as if solidified?

Every breath’s worth of gathered immortal material perhaps equates to several hundred years to a thousand years of an ordinary Great Emperor’s achievement.

"It’s done."

Lin Yuan suddenly opened his eyes.

Looking at the immortal material already thoroughly formed in front of him, a peculiar expression appeared on his face.
